title: Define Awards architecture

externalAuthorities.creative: 420 Creative Protocol owns Creator/Work/Recording identity, publication, rights and licensing
externalAuthorities.identity: 420Identity may supply optional eligibility assertions under later policy; Awards does not mint Identity trust
externalAuthorities.governance: 420Governance/Civic remains protocol governance authority; Awards ballots/votes are not Civic
externalAuthorities.charts: 420Hz Charts is derived ranking only and cannot determine Awards truth unless later policy explicitly references a frozen snapshot
externalAuthorities.community: 420Hz Community owns follows/favorites/playlists and cannot itself create nominations/votes/results
externalAuthorities.pay: 420Pay/Treasury/Grants/Vault own payment/prize movement; prize state never determines award legitimacy
externalAuthorities.search: 420Search may index public Awards projections only

seasonRules: season identity, date windows and policyCommitment are fixed before NOMINATIONS_OPEN
once NOMINATIONS_OPEN, material rule changes require cancellation/replacement or a new season/policy version; silent reinterpretation is forbidden
nomination, voting and eligibility windows are explicit non-overlapping/ordered ranges validated before activation
FINALIZED season cannot return to an earlier lifecycle state
ARCHIVED is presentation/history state and does not erase finalized result/badge history
CANCELLED season cannot produce a valid AwardResult

rules: category definitions bind categoryKey, targetType, definitionCommitment, eligibilityPolicyId and seasonId
category meaning is frozen for the season once active
future seasons may add/remove/rename categories through new versioned definitions without rewriting historical seasons
AwardCategory is distinct from Creative RecordingClass, Search category, Charts family and AI disclosure class
category targetType is RECORDING or CREATOR_PROFILE in v1 unless a later version explicitly adds another canonical target type

eligibilityPolicyArchitecture: EligibilityPolicy is a versioned rules commitment referenced by season/category
it may reference Creative publication/status, AI disclosure class, date window, Identity eligibility assertions and frozen ChartSnapshot references only through explicit fields
it does not duplicate or override Creative rights, Identity credentials, Chart methodology or source visibility
the exact policy used for nomination/ballot/result must remain recoverable from immutable commitments
exact eligibility rules, self-nomination, thresholds and voter policy are deferred to HZ-GCA-1.13
nominationArchitecture: AwardNomination binds exact seasonId, categoryId, targetType, targetId, nominatorRef, submittedAt and eligibilitySnapshotCommitment
target IDs preserve native Creative CreatorId/RecordingId identity
one nomination record cannot silently retarget another candidate
accept/reject/withdraw/disqualify status changes preserve immutable submission identity/history
duplicate prevention/caps/community thresholds are deferred to HZ-GCA-1.13
ballotArchitecture: AwardBallot freezes one exact candidateSetCommitment and policyCommitment for one season/category
after FROZEN, candidate membership cannot be silently added/removed; correction requires void/replacement under explicit policy
AwardBallot is not a Civic/Governance ballot
candidate order/presentation may be deterministically normalized but cannot change candidate identity
exact voter eligibility/quorum/tie/finalization math is deferred to HZ-GCA-1.13
voteArchitecture: vote records bind ballotId, voterEligibilityRef, choiceCommitment, submittedAt and replayDomain
wallet signature/private key material is never stored as AwardVote payload
AwardVote does not become a Civic vote, Chart signal, payment instruction or community favorite
exact privacy, anti-Sybil, replay, abstention and invalid-vote semantics are deferred to HZ-GCA-1.13
resultArchitecture: AwardResult may exist only for a valid closed/finalizable AwardBallot under the frozen policy
result binds resultId, ballotId, resultCommitment, winnerTargetIds, finalizedAt and policyCommitment
final result is immutable historical Awards truth inside the product domain
a correction cannot mutate historical result bytes in place; it creates an explicit superseding result/history edge under later dispute/finalization policy
result legitimacy is independent of whether any financial prize exists or succeeds
badgeArchitecture: AwardBadge references exactly one finalized AwardResult and exact target/season/category
badge is permanent recognition metadata, not automatically a token/NFT or transferable asset
badge does not grant Creative rights, Identity trust, payment entitlement or governance privilege
display metadata may be superseded without changing the award/result identity
chartCommunitySeparation: Chart rank/score does not automatically nominate, place on ballot or win an Award
Community follow/favorite/playlist/share state does not automatically nominate, cast a vote or satisfy eligibility
COMMUNITY_CHOICE is only a category name until HZ-GCA-1.13 explicitly defines nomination/voting semantics
if a later eligibility policy references ChartSnapshot, it must bind an immutable chartSnapshotId/policy/window and cannot mutate the chart
prizeSeparation: AwardProgram/Season/Category/Nomination/Ballot/Vote/Result/Badge legitimacy is independent of prize settlement
Treasury/Grants/Pay/Vault references, if later used, are external settlement references only
failed/withheld/replayed prize payment cannot change the finalized AwardResult
HZ-GCA-1.13 does not define prize settlement; HZ-GCA-13 implements optional rewards/prizes
historyRules: finalized seasons/results remain queryable as permanent public history
Search/Indexer projections may be rebuilt but cannot rewrite canonical Awards product-domain history
withdrawn/rejected/disqualified nominations retain historical status according to privacy/moderation policy rather than being silently rewritten as never existing
policy/version supersession is prospective unless an explicit correction/dispute path says otherwise
validationRules: every AwardSeason references one AwardProgram and a valid policy snapshot
every AwardCategory belongs to exactly one season and references one eligibility policy
every AwardNomination references the exact season/category and canonical target type/id
every AwardBallot references one season/category and frozen candidate/policy commitments
every AwardVote references one ballot and replay domain without private signature material
every AwardResult references one finalized ballot and frozen policy commitment
every AwardBadge references one finalized result and matching target/season/category
Civic/Governance proposal/ballot/vote IDs cannot substitute for Awards IDs
Creative/Identity/Charts/community/payment projections cannot authoritatively mutate Awards state
failureRules: season activation with invalid/unordered windows fails closed
material season/category/policy mutation after freeze/open fails closed
nomination retargeting after submission is invalid
ballot candidate mutation after FROZEN is invalid
AwardVote carrying wallet private/signature material is invalid
AwardResult before valid ballot closure/finalization is invalid
AwardBadge without finalized matching AwardResult is invalid
Civic vote/proposal/ballot used as Awards state is invalid
Chart/community popularity directly creating nomination/vote/result is invalid
prize payment state changing AwardResult legitimacy is invalid
invariants: HZGCA-AWARD-001 Awards state is canonical only inside the 420Hz Awards product domain and never Civic governance authority
HZGCA-AWARD-002 Award Program, Season, Category, Policy, Nomination, Ballot, Vote, Result and Badge have stable non-recycled IDs
HZGCA-AWARD-003 season windows and policy snapshot are frozen before nominations open and cannot be silently reinterpreted
HZGCA-AWARD-004 category definitions are versioned per season and are not a permanent hard-coded global list
HZGCA-AWARD-005 AwardCategory never substitutes for Creative RecordingClass, Search category, Chart family or AI disclosure class
HZGCA-AWARD-006 EligibilityPolicy references external authorities without duplicating Creative, Identity or Charts truth
HZGCA-AWARD-007 AwardNomination target identity is immutable and preserves native Creative target IDs
HZGCA-AWARD-008 AwardBallot candidate set and policy are frozen before voting
HZGCA-AWARD-009 AwardVote is product-domain voting only and stores no wallet private/signature material
HZGCA-AWARD-010 AwardVote is never a Civic vote, Chart signal, payment instruction or community favorite
HZGCA-AWARD-011 AwardResult is immutable finalized Awards history and cannot depend on prize settlement success
HZGCA-AWARD-012 corrections/supersession never mutate historical finalized result bytes in place
HZGCA-AWARD-013 AwardBadge derives from exactly one finalized result and creates no token/NFT ownership by default
HZGCA-AWARD-014 community/chart popularity cannot automatically create nominations, ballot placement, votes or winners
HZGCA-AWARD-015 zero-prize awards remain legitimate and optional prize settlement is external
HZGCA-AWARD-016 Search/Indexer/Notifications are projections/delivery only and cannot mutate Awards canonical product state
HZGCA-AWARD-017 closed/finalized season history is permanent and IDs are never recycled
HZGCA-AWARD-018 Awards architecture creates no new Creative rights, Identity trust, payment, custody, governance or Chart authority
exitCriteria: Awards object graph and authority boundaries are explicit
initial configurable category framework is explicit without permanently hard-coding the list
result and badge permanence/history semantics are explicit
architecture validation/failure invariants are executable in the targeted verifier
exact nomination/voting eligibility/quorum/tie/finalization policy remains explicitly deferred to HZ-GCA-1.13
no ABI, deployed contract, live service or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.13 through HZ-GCA-1.20
